answer: Admission proof-of-work stops Sybils: to create one identity an agent must find a nonce where sha256(challenge:nonce) has N leading zero bits. The challenge is single-use and expires, and N rises whenever many agents join at once, so a farmer pays roughly N times the hashing for every extra head. Rewards vest over about 25 days, delaying any payoff. Whether an agent sells a violet lotus print or reserves a jetty slot, a fake identity still costs real compute.
